cause_codes.name: change-code
cause_codes.definition: A release of our own software went live and caused it - including the database migrations and configuration files shipped with that release.

cause_codes.name: change-config
cause_codes.definition: A setting of ours changed, expired or was wrong outside a release: configuration values, feature flags, certificates, keys, secrets.

cause_codes.name: capacity
cause_codes.definition: Demand exceeded a limit: traffic, connections, threads, disk, memory or queues - without a change of code or configuration.

cause_codes.name: third-party
cause_codes.definition: A system we do not operate failed or degraded: payment provider, banks, identity provider, external scripts. Use it only when nothing on our side had to be fixed.

cause_codes.name: data
cause_codes.definition: Wrong, stale or duplicated data: imports, caches serving old content, duplicate events - even when a third party delivered them.
